dxgive.evidence_source: [page/12/Text/5] The results of this study clearly demonstrate the efficacy of the Coping with Depression Course for depressed adolescents. Both treatment groups significantly improved at posttreatment, with substantial reductions in diagnoses and depression scores
dxgive.warning: Applies to both 'Adolescents-and-Parent group' and 'Adolescent-Only group' samples.

Source.evidence_source: [page/13/Text/5] Although there was no differential effect on the depression measures, there was a significant effect between treatment groups on CBCL scores, suggesting that parents who were actively involved in the treatment program saw their teens in a more positive light at the end of treatment. It is important to note, however, at the 6-month follow-up, that the parents of the Adolescent-Only group continued to become more positive in their CBCL ratings, matching the level of the Parent-and-Adolescent group. Paralleling these results was a significant reduction in parent-reported parent-adolescent conflict, from posttreatment to the 6-month follow-up for both groups.
Source.warning: Applies to both 'Adolescents-and-Parent group' and 'Adolescent-Only group' samples.
